definitions.deltaE: Full-canvas mean per-pixel OKLab distance, canonical oklabDeltaE
definitions.bodyDeltaE: Mean per-pixel OKLab distance over the declared union eroded 6 CSS px
definitions.body: Declared union eroded 6 CSS px: linear Rec.709 Y mean and population SD, and mean per-pixel OKLab chroma
definitions.geometry: How the page was actually framed, read back per row: the viewport is the declared matrix canvas, and a row exists only where the page reported no problems and agreed with the declaration on canvas, requested scale and devicePixelRatio
definitions.notRead: The three bed ids carrying §5.130's holdout role are captured by no row here: the holdout is spent and this read does not produce a second vitrea-against-native distance for one under another name
